description: This file contains utility functions for formatting durations, bytes, dates, logs, and generating REST API endpoints related to Spark UI components. It also includes functions for error message handling and UI node creation.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string with units (ms, s, min, h).

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Converts a byte count into a human-readable string with appropriate size units.

methods.name: padZeroes
methods.description: Pads a number with a leading zero if necessary to ensure two digits.

methods.name: formatTimeMillis
methods.description: Formats a timestamp in milliseconds into a date string or '-' if invalid.

methods.name: formatDateString
methods.description: Converts a Date object into a formatted date-time string.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Retrieves the user's local timezone, with fallback parsing.

methods.name: formatLogsCells
methods.description: Generates HTML links for log files if display type, otherwise returns log keys.

methods.name: getStandAloneAppId
methods.description: Retrieves the application ID from the URL or via REST API if running in standalone mode.

methods.name: ConvertDurationString
methods.description: Converts a duration string (e.g., '12ms', '2s', '3min', '1h') into milliseconds for sorting.

methods.name: createTemplateURI
methods.description: Constructs a URI for a template HTML file based on the current base URI and app ID.

methods.name: setDataTableDefaults
methods.description: Sets default options for DataTables plugin, including state saving and page length.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date string or timestamp into a human-readable date string.

methods.name: createRESTEndPointForExecutorsPage
methods.description: Builds the REST API endpoint URL for fetching all executors for a given application.

methods.name: createRESTEndPointForMiscellaneousProcess
methods.description: Builds the REST API endpoint URL for fetching miscellaneous process info for an application.

methods.name: getBaseURI
methods.description: Returns the base URI of the current document.

methods.name: detailsUINode
methods.description: Creates HTML for a toggleable details node, used for error messages.

methods.name: errorSummary
methods.description: Extracts a brief summary and multiline flag from an error message.

methods.name: errorMessageCell
methods.description: Creates an HTML cell with error message summary and details toggle.

methods.name: stringAbbreviate
methods.description: Shortens a string to a limit and adds a toggle for full content.
